newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold exchange prices mixed, volume eases.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold exchange prices mixed, volume eases.

text.p: Prices on the Istanbul gold exchange ended mixed on Monday with volume falling to 1,140 kilos from 1,300 on Friday.

Gold closed at $379.70 an ounce, down from Friday's $380.35 in line with the drop in European markets. But it rose to 1,214,100 lira per gram from Friday's 1,212,850 lira due to the lira's decline against the dollar.
Dealers said volume more than doubled to 705 kilos in the second session from 335 in the morning as prices receded along with the world market trends.

"The expectation that gold would not fall much further had the biggest effect on afternoon buying. There were also some buyers making up for weekend sales and banks demanding for gold for currency trading purposes," a bank dealer said.
Of the total daily turnover, 66.3 percent was in lira terms. --Istanbul newroom +0212-2750875
